inspiration.observed_pattern: Several source-specific SELECT branches use UNION ALL BY NAME to align differently named measures, then aggregate the aligned nullable columns and retain only entities represented by every branch.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as a returns-channel summary. DuckDB's name-based union is represented with an explicit common projection and NULL placeholders in a MariaDB-compatible UNION ALL CTE; grouped sums, per-channel presence counts, and deterministic ordering preserve the all-channel reporting contract without copying the benchmark schema or values.

fixture_notes: SKU-A and SKU-D appear in store, catalog, and web return feeds and are summarized; SKU-B lacks a web row and SKU-C lacks store and catalog rows, so the all-channel HAVING filter excludes both.
determinism_notes: SKU codes, source IDs, quantities, branch projections, presence conditions, and final ordering are fixed. No clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE store_returns_summary (return_id INT PRIMARY KEY, sku VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, units INT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE catalog_returns_summary (return_id INT PRIMARY KEY, sku VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, units INT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE web_returns_summary (return_id INT PRIMARY KEY, sku VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, units INT NOT NULL)

steps.sql: WITH channel_rollup AS (SELECT sku, units AS store_units, NULL AS catalog_units, NULL AS web_units FROM store_returns_summary UNION ALL SELECT sku, NULL, units, NULL FROM catalog_returns_summary UNION ALL SELECT sku, NULL, NULL, units FROM web_returns_summary) SELECT sku, COALESCE(SUM(store_units), 0) AS store_units, COALESCE(SUM(catalog_units), 0) AS catalog_units, COALESCE(SUM(web_units), 0) AS web_units, COUNT(store_units) AS store_rows, COUNT(catalog_units) AS catalog_rows, COUNT(web_units) AS web_rows FROM channel_rollup GROUP BY sku HAVING COUNT(store_units) > 0 AND COUNT(catalog_units) > 0 AND COUNT(web_units) > 0 ORDER BY sku

checks.sql: SELECT 'store' AS source_name, return_id, sku, units FROM store_returns_summary UNION ALL SELECT 'catalog', return_id, sku, units FROM catalog_returns_summary UNION ALL SELECT 'web', return_id, sku, units FROM web_returns_summary ORDER BY source_name, return_id
